quote: I mean, you must take living so seriously / that even at seventy, for example, you’ll plant olive trees— / and not for your children, either, / but because although you fear death you don’t believe it, / because living, I mean, weighs heavier.
source: Nâzim Hikmet, On Living, Part I, the closing lines, in Poems of Nazim Hikmet (trans. Randy Blasing and Mutlu Konuk, 1994)
